text:
amanda: FYI - Orion Logistics (reseller: FleetWave) proposed a special commercial for a 12-month pilot: net60 billing, 20% volume discount on usage, waive $8k setup fee, and a 12% reseller margin on billed usage. They want monthly invoices routed to FleetWave AP (they handle billing) and revenue share after invoiced payment. They can commit to a minimum of $40k/mo in billed usage during pilot. Need finance + legal on approvals.

jon: net60 is a hard no for new resellers without credit checks. also revenue share tied to reseller invoicing increases fraud/risk surface. do we have a reseller agreement on file?

felix: credit ops: if we keep net60, require a credit application + trade references and escrow of first 2 months' expected revenue OR reduce to net30 for first 3 invoices. reseller collects payment from end customer? who's legally the payer?

rachel: legal: we need a reseller addendum. revenue share must be governed by MSA Addendum X; need explicit invoicing flow (who issues invoice to end customer, who is our counterparty). Also reject any auto-waive of setup fee without exec signoff.

dan: commercial: Orion prefers net60 due to their AP, but they can accept net30 if we extend reseller margin to 14% and keep setup fee waived. they want the 20% discount because they'll bring multiple accounts after pilot.

amanda: proposed conservative terms for approval:

```
Pilot terms (12 months):
- Volume discount: 15% off list on usage during pilot (reduced from requested 20%)
- Reseller margin: 12% on collected payments to FleetWave
- Billing: monthly invoices to FleetWave, payment terms net30 for first 3 invoices, then net45 if on-time; no net60 until after credit review
- Setup fee: waived contingent on paying refundable onboarding deposit equal to $16k (applied to month 2 invoice)
- Minimum: $40k/mo billed usage during pilot; failure to meet minimum triggers reconciliation and possible clawback of discount
- Revenue share payments processed 30 days after cleared payment to Redwood.
```

felix: acceptable from credit ops, deposit covers risk. need FleetWave legal + KYC for reseller.

rachel: legal ok in principle. i'll draft reseller addendum and require clause: "no downstream settlement until Redwood receives cleared funds" and right to offset unpaid invoices against reseller margin. add audit rights.

jon: finance note - 15% discount approved by me for pilot but escalate to VP finance if extended beyond 12 months or if we grant >18% total discount stack. also require billing contact + PO for each onboarding account.

dan: i'll relay the 15% + deposit flow. can we signal to customer they'd get 20% after a successful Q1 post-pilot review?

amanda: yes we can offer conditional roadmap: 20% subject to meeting growth/ARPA metrics + clean payment history; requires VP signoff.

invoice-bot: invoice-22378 generated (onboarding deposit) for FleetWave/Orion - status: pending.

felix: once deposit clears, we can provision. we also need reseller tax form (W-9/managed equivalent).

amanda: great. thanks team. @rachel please drop the addendum draft here when ready; @jon will you escalate if any change>15%? I'll update the partner and request PO + tax docs.
